species.name: Rock pigeon
species.summary: A familiar city pigeon descended from domesticated rock doves.
species.identification: Often grey with two dark wing bars and an iridescent neck. Feral birds also have white, dark or reddish plumage.

species.pressures: Habitat considerations: Human feeding concentrates flocks. Avoid feeding or encouraging dependence on food waste.
species.singapore: NParks lists the rock dove as introduced in Singapore. City populations are feral birds, not a native pigeon population.
species.rarity: Common in suitable habitat; encounters are not guaranteed
